_comment: Single source of truth for Frame Roofing Utah's external identity. The audit-cta-integrity gate asserts that every customer-facing surface matches THESE values. Change identity here, not scattered across HTML. See scripts/audit-cta-integrity.mjs.

gbp._comment: Canonical Google Business Profile. cid + data_id verified 2026-06-01 against live Google Maps (h1 'Frame Restoration Utah', Heber City 40.5058,-111.4143). This is the 5-star profile the site scrapes via scripts/update-google-reviews.py.

_review_form_link_note: Official GBP 'Ask for reviews' short link (g.page/r/.../review). EMPTY until Landon (listing owner) provides it; review.html falls back to the cid maps link meanwhile. When filled, must be a g.page/r/ or search.google.com/local/writereview link.
_internal_phone_note: LANDON_PHONE — call-forward target behind the tracking number. MUST appear in zero published HTML. The gate blocks any published page that contains it in any format (tel:, dashed, dotted, parenthesized, +1).
_known_wrong_listing_note: cid 16833... resolved to an empty Salt Lake-valley coordinate (no business) — the dead listing review.html mistakenly pointed at. Listed so the gate hard-blocks it ever reappearing in a published page.
